stem: A 3-month-old infant has one week of coughing paroxysms with oxygen desaturation during episodes but normal saturations between episodes. Which vaccine-preventable disease is most likely?
explanation: Pertussis can cause paroxysmal cough with apnoea or desaturation in young infants, and is vaccine-preventable with pertussis-containing vaccines.
rationale: Pertussis can cause paroxysmal cough with apnoea or desaturation in young infants, and is vaccine-preventable with pertussis-containing vaccines.
